note: Diagnostic only, outside the product path. Each request is the EXACT wire content agentpkg.hostbridge.router.render() produces for the corresponding Meeting Agenda node — same skill instructions, same bundled output schema, same data — sent straight to Ollama. No agentpkg runtime, workflow, worker, budget, permission or audit took part, and no package was executed. Its only purpose is to choose the package's per-step timeouts from measurement.

write.note: The writer is the slowest single step: its input carries the plan and all three joined perspectives, and the exact-minute-sum constraint in the package's own validate assertions costs a long chain of thought.

worstObservedAcrossAllSessions.note: Combined with the earlier session in model-availability-latency.json and the 0.2.0 live run. These are the numbers the 0.2.1 timing policy was set from.
